$comment: Maps GDD §6.3 class ids to existing sprite keys in CLASS_SPRITES (assets/sprites/class_sprites.html). Sprites that exist in CLASS_SPRITES but DO NOT match a GDD class are listed under 'orphanSprites' for triage. Empty 'spriteKey' means the sprite needs to be authored or an existing sprite repurposed.

knight.note: CLASS_SPRITES key 'Tank' renders as 'Knight' (display name in viewer)

warden.note: Authored v0.20 — nature tank with antlered helm, vine pauldrons, branching staff.

shieldmage.note: Repurposed v0.20 — orphan Bulwark (tower-shield specialist) is the GDD shieldmage's tower-shield magic-tank.

gladiator.note: Repurposed v0.20 — orphan Dragoon's lance/spear silhouette fits the GDD Gladiator (crowd-pleaser, brief taunt, net + spear).

cleric.note: CLASS_SPRITES key 'Healer' = Cleric per GDD intent

templar.note: GDD places Templar as Healer; CLASS_SPRITES groups it under Divine — keep sprite, family per GDD

bloodpriest.note: Authored v0.20 — crimson robes, raised dagger, floating blood drops; heals via damage dealt.

lifebinder.note: Repurposed v0.20 — orphan Apothecary (scientific healer) fits the GDD Lifebinder (chain heals + soul tether vial-y aesthetic).

hunter.note: CLASS_SPRITES 'Beastmaster' = Hunter per GDD (beast companion). Also matches 'beastmaster' farlands class — see orphanSprites.

falconer.note: Repurposed v0.20 — orphan Valkyrie's winged silhouette fits the GDD Falconer (bird scout, dive bomb).

assassin.note: CLASS_SPRITES key 'Rogue' = Assassin per GDD intent

trickster.note: CLASS_SPRITES key 'Saboteur' fits Trickster's status-effect identity

bladestorm.note: CLASS_SPRITES 'Ninja' covers multi-hit AoE rogue silhouette

reaper.note: Repurposed v0.20 — orphan DeathKnight's death/skull-armor silhouette fits the GDD Reaper (death-themed kill-bonus rogue).

arcanist.note: CLASS_SPRITES 'Mage' = Arcanist per GDD intent (pure burst caster)

spiritualist.note: Authored v0.20 — totemic mask, beaded shoulder cape, ghost-trail particles.

beastmaster.note: Authored v0.20 — leather/fur, coiled whip, wolf companion at feet (the marksman 'Hunter' keeps the original 'Beastmaster' sprite key).

astromancer.note: Authored v0.20 — deep blue robe, star particles, crescent crown.

sandwalker.note: Authored v0.20 — tan robes, hooded face, scimitar, sand-swirl particles at feet.

voidcaller.note: CLASS_SPRITES 'Bloodmage' adapted (HP-cost dark magic vibe matches Voidcaller)

orphanSprites.$comment: Sprites that exist in CLASS_SPRITES but don't directly match a GDD class. Either repurpose, rename, or retire.

summary.note_v0_20: Sprite gap closed: every GDD class has a procedural sprite. Authored 6 new (warden, bloodpriest, spiritualist, beastmaster2, astromancer, sandwalker) and repurposed 5 orphans (Bulwark→shieldmage, Apothecary→lifebinder, DeathKnight→reaper, Valkyrie→falconer, Dragoon→gladiator).
